{{Current events|year=2021|month=05|day=7|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[2021 Jerusalem clashes]]
***At least 178 [[Palestinians]] are injured in clashes with [[Israeli police]] at the [[al-Aqsa Mosque]] and elsewhere in [[East Jerusalem]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/7/jerusalem-dozens-of-palestinians-hurt-in-al-aqsa-clashes (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2020 Nagorno-Karabakh war]]
**[[Armenia]] says that it has returned all [[prisoners of war]] to [[Azerbaijan]] under Article 8 of the [[2020 Nagorno-Karabakh ceasefire agreement|November 9 agreement]]. [http://asbarez.com/202351/armenia-has-returned-all-azerbaijani-pows-says-yerevan/ (Asbarez)]
*[[Insurgency in Southeastern Nigeria]]
**At least seven [[Nigeria Police Force|police]] officers are killed in a [[shooting spree]] in [[Rivers State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-57040121 (BBC)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*A [[tower block]] at [[New Providence Wharf]], [[London]], [[United Kingdom]], catches fire. The block is clad in the same material as that which was on [[Grenfell Tower]], which [[Grenfell Tower fire|caught fire]] in 2017. More than 100 [[firefighter]]s and 20 [[fire engine]]s were sent to the scene. [https://metro.co.uk/2021/05/07/fire-breaks-out-in-canary-wharf-flats-with-same-cladding-used-on-grenfell-14537101/?ito=socialmetrouktwitter (Metro)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[India]] reports a world record of 414,188 new cases of [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 21.49 million. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/7/indias-covid-cases-rise-by-record-414188-deaths-swell-by-3915 (Al Jazeera)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****[[Japan]] extends the [[state of emergency]] for [[Tokyo]], [[Osaka Prefecture|Osaka]], [[Hyogo Prefecture|Hyogo]], and [[Kyoto Prefecture|Kyoto]] until May 31. It also declares a state of emergency for [[Aichi Prefecture|Aichi]] and [[Fukuoka Prefecture|Fukuoka Prefectures]]. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2021/05/07/national/state-emergency-extension-2/ (''The Japan Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[Malaysia]] reports 4,498 new cases in the past 24 hours, which is the first time the country has reported 4,000 new cases since February. It subsequently brings the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 432,425. [https://www.malaymail.com/news/malaysia/2021/05/07/covid-19-cases-shoot-up-to-4498-today-with-1424-alone-in-selangor/1972446 (''Malay Mail'')] 
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]], [[Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
***The [[United Kingdom]] adds [[Turkey]], the [[Maldives]] and [[Nepal]] to its "red list" of countries, where travellers will be required to [[quarantine]] in a hotel for 10 days upon their return to the UK at their own expense. Twelve countries are also added to the government's "green list", including [[Portugal]] and [[Israel]]. This new "traffic light system" will take effect on May 17, when international travel is no longer illegal. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-57026936 (BBC)]

'''International relations'''
*[[France–Lebanon relations]], [[Lebanese liquidity crisis]]
**French Foreign Minister [[Jean-Yves Le Drian]] threatens to step up pressure against [[politics of Lebanon|Lebanese politicians]] he accuses of committing "collective suicide" by failing to pull the country out of [[economy of Lebanon|its economic meltdown]]. During his visit to [[Beirut]], Le Drian said that punitive actions could be taken by France and the [[European Union]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/french-envoy-warns-lebanese-leaders-against-collective-suicide-2021-05-07/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Colonial Pipeline cyberattack]]
**[[Colonial Pipeline]], which supplies 45% of the [[East Coast of the United States|U.S. East Coast]]'s fuel supply, suffers a malware attack that causes a shutdown of their system. [https://www.cnbc.com/2021/05/08/colonial-pipeline-shuts-pipeline-operations-after-cyberattack.html (CNBC)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Elections in the United Kingdom]]
**[[2021 Senedd election]]
***The [[Welsh Labour Party]] wins a record sixth term in office. With 52 out of 60 seats declared, Labour has won 30 seats in the [[Senedd Cymru|Senedd]], reaching a working majority and equalling their best performance. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-wales-politics-57009547 (BBC)]
**[[2021 Scottish Parliament election]]
***After the first day of counting, the [[Scottish National Party]] gains three key constituency seats from the [[Scottish Conservatives]] and [[Scottish Labour Party|Scottish Labour]], while missing out in several others. The remaining seats will be counted on Saturday. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-scotland-scotland-politics-57014885 (BBC)]

'''Science and technology'''
*A whole-[[genome]] study confirms the existence of four distinct [[species]] of [[giraffe]]s, corroborating the conclusions of a 2016 [[DNA]] study; previously, it was believed that all giraffes were members of a single species. The study also supports the existence of seven [[subspecies]] of giraffes. [http://www.sci-news.com/biology/four-giraffe-species-09632.html (Sci-News)]

'''Sports'''
*[[UEFA]] reveals that nine of the 12 [[association football]] [[Football team|clubs]] that planned to participate in the suspended [[European Super League]] proposal agree, through a "club commitment declaration", to financial sanctions imposed by the governing body. This includes a five percent cut in their revenue for one season. Only [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]], [[Juventus F.C.|Juventus]], and [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] did not sign the declaration, although UEFA has committed to "take appropriate action" against clubs still committed to the Super League. [https://www.iol.co.za/sport/soccer/uefa-champions-league/nine-clubs-sanctioned-by-uefa-over-super-league-project-as-three-hold-out-6c522575-a700-452e-96fd-0c048f213897 (IOL)]
